reproductions.notes:
The game files are from Prince of Persia 1.4, but the movie uses the cracked PRINCE.EXE (MD5: ebfdb86f490dd778e2458c6b609cffc9, size: 110855 bytes)
To get the correct CONFIG.DAT (MD5: 6d61064d668736c2db86cb8a2fcf95b6) and SETUP.DAT (MD5: f2749b0d91760afa85f27f13ca59542e) run SETUP.EXE in DOSBox and use the following settings:

Digital/sound device: Sound Blaster Pro (then press M to change settings)
I/O address: 220h
IRQ: 5
DMA: 1
Music synthesizer: Sound Blaster Pro

The game directory must contain exactly (i.e., no additional files):

SNDDRVRS\
    DSB_PRO.DRV
    MSB_PRO.DRV
    PRESET33.DEF
CONFIG.DAT
DIGI.DRV
DIGISND1.DAT
DIGISND2.DAT
DIGISND3.DAT
FAT.DAT
GUARD.DAT
GUARD1.DAT
GUARD2.DAT
IBM_SND1.DAT
IBM_SND2.DAT
KID.DAT
LEVELS.DAT
MIDI.DRV
MIDISND1.DAT
MIDISND2.DAT
PRESETS.DEF
PRINCE.DAT
PRINCE.EXE
PV.DAT
SETUP.CFG
SETUP.DAT
SETUP.EXE
SHADOW.DAT
SKEL.DAT
TITLE.DAT
VDUNGEON.DAT
VIZIER.DAT
VPALACE.DAT

The resulting JPC-RR HDD image ID should then be bcfbff90ffa8456e4862c7da84eae440
